🌎 🌴 After COP24 in My City took place at Cow & Dog in Wangsimni on January 5, 2019! 🌳 🌏

In the first session, GEYK members who had attended COP24 shared their experiences in a talk show. In the second, everyone took part in a mock international climate negotiation based on the IPCC’s Special Report on Global Warming of 1.5°C, a major topic at COP24. We also had delicious vegan cinnamon rolls.

Thank you to everyone who took such an active part. GEYK will keep learning and taking action on climate change. :D
